Find an equation in the paper

  1. Open your project and choose PDF (⌥⌘P).
  2. Select an outline heading or equation card to reveal its location.
  3. Command-click an equation/figure in the PDF to select its source card.
  4. Copy the selected equation or edit a presentation version.
  • The outline follows headings across included files; parent headings include descendants.
  • Labels are manual groups, separate from the document outline.
  • Source mode opens the matching file and line.
  • Custom variants navigate to their original source; newly created equations have no paper location.
  • Resize the PDF/inspector using their dividers; widths are remembered.

Refresh and troubleshoot

  • After external source edits: Rescan; a visible PDF rebuilds too.
  • Rebuild PDF (⇧⌘R) rebuilds only the document.
  • A failed rebuild retains the last PDF; navigation waits for a successful build.
  • LaTeX requires SyncTeX; several equations on one source line can resolve to the first card.
  • Generated content may have no navigation target; see limits.
  • Previous/next page: ⌘[ / ⌘]; zoom: ⌘+ / ⌘−; fit: ⌘0.
